SELECT o_orderkey, o_totalprice, c_acctbal FROM orders JOIN customer ON o_custkey = c_custkey WHERE TRUE ORDER BY o_totalprice ASC, o_orderkey ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT o_shippriority, o_orderstatus, COUNT(o_totalprice) AS a0, SUM(o_totalprice) AS a1, MAX(o_totalprice) AS a2 FROM orders WHERE (o_orderpriority = '2-HIGH') GROUP BY o_shippriority, o_orderstatus HAVING COUNT(o_totalprice) > 19 ORDER BY a0 ASC, o_shippriority ASC, o_orderstatus ASC LIMIT 100

SELECT l_shipinstruct, MAX(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS a0, AVG(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS a1, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS a2 FROM lineitem JOIN supplier ON l_suppkey = s_suppkey JOIN nation ON s_nationkey = n_nationkey WHERE (l_shipmode IN ('MAIL', 'RAIL', 'SHIP')) AND (l_extendedprice < 51216.75) GROUP BY l_shipinstruct ORDER BY a0 ASC, l_shipinstruct ASC

SELECT l_linestatus, MAX(l_extendedprice) AS a0, SUM(l_tax) AS a1, SUM(l_tax) AS a2 FROM lineitem WHERE (l_shipinstruct IN ('COLLECT COD', 'DELIVER IN PERSON', 'NONE', 'TAKE BACK RETURN')) GROUP BY l_linestatus
SELECT o_orderkey, o_totalprice FROM orders WHERE (o_totalprice < 25803.23) AND (o_orderdate < 10008) AND (o_orderstatus <> 'P') ORDER BY o_totalprice ASC, o_orderkey ASC LIMIT 10
SELECT ps_partkey, COUNT(DISTINCT ps_suppkey) AS n FROM partsupp WHERE TRUE GROUP BY ps_partkey HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ps_suppkey) > 1 ORDER BY n DESC, ps_partkey ASC
SELECT DISTINCT l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode FROM lineitem WHERE (l_returnflag = 'R') AND (l_receiptdate >= 9220)
SELECT DISTINCT l_shipinstruct, l_returnflag FROM lineitem JOIN orders ON l_orderkey = o_orderkey WHERE (l_quantity >= 6.0 AND l_quantity <= 16.0)
SELECT SUM(ps_supplycost) AS a0 FROM partsupp WHERE (ps_availqty >= 9799) AND (ps_supplycost < 899.89)
SELECT c_mktsegment, MIN(c_acctbal) AS a0, SUM(c_acctbal) AS a1, MAX(c_acctbal) AS a2 FROM customer JOIN nation ON c_nationkey = n_nationkey WHERE TRUE GROUP BY c_mktsegment

SELECT SUM(l_quantity) AS a0, MIN(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS a1, COUNT(l_tax) AS a2 FROM lineitem WHERE (l_shipinstruct IN ('COLLECT COD', 'DELIVER IN PERSON', 'TAKE BACK RETURN')) AND (l_quantity >= 4.0)
SELECT c_custkey, c_acctbal FROM customer WHERE (c_acctbal < 990.7) ORDER BY c_acctbal DESC, c_custkey ASC LIMIT 50
